payload.body_you:
Money gets personal here. The rate you never raised. The subscription still charging every month. The job that pays enough on paper but takes your whole nervous system with it. The purchase meant to make a difficult week feel better. Saturn moving through your 2nd house makes it harder to avoid what your life actually costs.

You need numbers you can trust. Know what comes in, what goes out, what you owe, and which expenses are still there because canceling them felt easier to postpone. Ask for the rate. Send the invoice. Save toward the choice you keep saying you cannot afford yet. The point is not deprivation. It is making sure your money supports the life you say you want.
